Subject: Fwd: Redwood Inference demo — guest SSO block — suggested workaround

Vivek / Lauren —

Thanks for the heads-up, Jamie. This is a common SSO policy with larger customers. Proposed plan:

1) Create a dedicated Zoom meeting (hosted by Lauren — she has a Zoom account not tied to a GSuite organizer). Add a meeting passcode and phone dial-in as a fallback.
2) Regenerate the .ics attached to the new Zoom meeting (redwood-demo-zoom-20270811.ics) and send directly to Jamie — do not use an internal-only calendar share.
3) CC the guest on the email with the new invite and include plain-text Zoom link and dial-in details in the body (helps some corporate clients that strip calendar attachments).
4) If they still see a block, we can provide a one-click Webex/phone dial-in (expensive but available).

Action items: Lauren, can you spin up the Zoom meeting and share the .ics to me + Vivek? Vivek, please reply to Jamie once Lauren confirms. I'll log this in HubSpot under ACME-371 and flag as scheduling friction in the demo notes.

Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
